title: The Red Nucleus in Motor Control and Autism Spectrum Disorder
title_zh: 红核在运动控制与自闭症谱系障碍中的作用
abstract: Neuromotor differences of motor coordination, timing, postural regulation, and prospective motor control are common and emerge early in autism spectrum disorder (ASD). However, their underlying neural mechanisms remain incompletely understood, with existing research emphasising cortical and cerebellar systems. This review re-examines the red nucleus (RN), a midbrain structure embedded within cortical, cerebellar, and olivary motor pathways, as an underexplored component of distributed sensorimotor networks. We synthesise evidence from comparative neuroanatomy, animal experiments, human neuroimaging, movement disorders, and autism research, distinguishing direct RN findings from broader circuit-level inferences. Neuroimaging studies have reported RN-region susceptibility differences in autistic children, including an exploratory association with fine-motor development, but reproducible links to specific motor processes and RN-related causal mechanisms remain unestablished. We therefore propose a testable hypothesis that differences in RN structure, function, or connectivity may be associated with specific dimensions of motor function in autism. Error-related sensorimotor adaptation provides a primary experimental target, complemented by prospective motor control. Future investigations combining RN-sensitive neuroimaging, quantitative motor assessment, and transdiagnostic comparisons with developmental coordination disorder may determine whether RN-related measures provide explanatory information beyond sensorimotor systems. This framework positions the RN as a candidate component of autism-related motor networks.
abstract_zh: 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）中常见的运动协调、时间、姿势调节和前瞻性运动控制的运动神经差异在早期即可出现。然而，其潜在的神经机制仍未完全阐明，现有研究主要强调皮层和小脑系统。本综述重新审视了红核（RN），这是一个嵌入皮层、小脑和橄榄运动通路中的中脑结构，作为分布式感知运动网络中被忽视的组成部分。我们综合了比较神经解剖、动物实验、人类神经影像、运动障碍以及自闭症研究的证据，区分了直接的RN发现与更广泛的电路层面推论。神经影像研究报道，自闭症儿童的RN区域存在易感性差异，其中包括与精细运动发展的探索性关联，但尚未确立与特定运动过程的可重复联系以及与RN相关的因果机制。因此，我们提出了一个可检验的假设，即RN的结构、功能或连接性差异可能与自闭症中特定的运动功能维度相关。错误相关的感知运动适应是主要的实验目标，前瞻性运动控制是补充。未来的研究将结合RN敏感神经影像、量化运动评估以及与发育协调障碍的跨诊断比较，以确定RN相关指标是否能在感知运动系统之外提供解释性信息。该框架将红核定位为自闭症相关运动网络的候选组成部分。
